lines.zh: 四格高的身子，走起来地动
lines.en: Four blocks tall, and the ground moves as I walk

lines.zh: 我一脚踩下去，树就折了
lines.en: One step of mine snaps a tree

lines.zh: 尾巴在身后扫，压平了草
lines.en: My tail sweeps behind and flattens the grass

lines.zh: 我的呼吸像雷在远处滚
lines.en: My breathing rumbles like distant thunder
One step, and the hill shudders

lines.zh: 我弓着背走，手掌快碰地
lines.en: I walk hunched, palms near the ground
The moon is still out, so I will not stop

lines.zh: 这么粗的腿，迈一步很沉
lines.en: Legs this thick make every stride heavy
The stones under my feet crumble to sand

lines.zh: 我不绕路，挡着的都撞开
lines.en: I do not detour, whatever blocks me gets smashed
My fur glows pale in the night
I drag my tail across the ridge
I lift my head, the moon is overhead

lines.zh: 我喘着气，白雾从嘴里出来
lines.en: I pant, mist pouring from my mouth
My clenched fist is bigger than a head
I stand with my teeth bared
My tail beats the ground again and again

lines.zh: 这具身子不是我的，可我用着
lines.en: This body is not mine, yet I wear it

lines.zh: 我看着月亮，眼睛移不开
lines.en: I stare at the moon and cannot look away
What comes from my throat is not human
Grass and dirt cling to my fur

lines.zh: 我抓了抓胸口，那里发烫
lines.en: I claw at my chest, it is burning

lines.zh: 风穿过林子，我闻得到血
lines.en: Wind moves through the trees and I smell blood

lines.zh: 我一动不动，可身体在颤
lines.en: I am still, but my body trembles
My mind is muddled, only anger is left

lines.zh: 抬头的时候，脖子发出响
lines.en: When I lift my head, my neck creaks
You are by my feet, comically small

lines.zh: 我低头，鼻孔里喷出热气
lines.en: I lower my head and hot breath shoots from my nostrils

lines.zh: 你这点个头，我一只手就够
lines.en: Your size, one hand is enough

lines.zh: 我往前凑，牙齿比你手臂长
lines.en: I lean in, my teeth are longer than your arm
The smell on you is fear

lines.zh: 我盯着你，眼睛红得发亮
lines.en: I stare at you, my eyes red and bright
Do not move, I am still looking

lines.zh: 我的影子把你整个人盖住了
lines.en: My shadow covers all of you
Your neck must ache looking up
I open my mouth and the sound is deep
Your hands are shaking, I see them
I raise a hand, five fingers spread

lines.zh: 这片地方小得很，你藏不住
lines.en: This place is small, you cannot hide
You are still standing there, that is good

lines.zh: 我想起来了，我原来也是这个样子
lines.en: I remember now, I used to be shaped like you

lines.zh: 你别怕，我控制不了多久
lines.en: Do not be afraid, I cannot hold on much longer

lines.zh: 我歪头，牙缝里全是口水
lines.en: I tilt my head, drool between my teeth

lines.zh: 你的影子在动，我看见了
lines.en: Your shadow moved, I saw it
It hurts, but pain fuels me
I roar and the trees shake
That woke me up a little
Thick hide, not easy to bring down
I wipe my mouth, the blood is hot

lines.zh: 伤口疼，脑子疼得更厉害
lines.en: The wound aches, my head aches more
I give half a step and the hill moves
You dare strike back, that is bold
I only feel heat, not fear
I grit my teeth and they grind

lines.zh: 你手上那点东西，不够一口
lines.en: What is in your hand is not one mouthful

lines.zh: 我低头闻，鼻息吹翻了你的头发
lines.en: I lower my head and my breath blows your hair back
A body this size needs a lot of food

lines.zh: 你举得再高，我也够得着
lines.en: Hold it as high as you like, I can reach
I do not eat this, I want something else
Step back, do not stand at my mouth

lines.zh: 这点东西，塞不住我的牙
lines.en: That will not fill a gap in my teeth

lines.zh: 我伸手，东西连人一起抓
lines.en: I reach out and grab the thing with the person

lines.zh: 你留着吧，我等下自己找
lines.en: Keep it, I will find my own
Hitting me is like hitting a tree

lines.zh: 我晃了晃，脚下的土翻了
lines.en: I sway and the soil turns over

lines.zh: 别贴着我，我这身毛很烫
lines.en: Do not press against me, my fur is hot
My tail swept you aside

lines.zh: 我低头看了一眼，又抬起来
lines.en: I glance down at you and lift my head again

lines.zh: 这一下，你的骨头该响了吧
lines.en: That should have made your bones sound

lines.zh: 我往边上让了半步，地面塌了
lines.en: Half a step aside and the ground caves

lines.zh: 你贴着我的腿站着，很危险
lines.en: Standing against my leg is dangerous
One shift of mine and you are squeezed away
Again, and I step down

lines.zh: 这具身子里，还有一个人在
lines.en: There is still a person inside this body

lines.zh: 我不认得你，也不认得自己
lines.en: I do not know you, nor myself

lines.zh: 月亮照着，我脑子里只有打
lines.en: Under this moon, only fighting is in my head
Stay back, I cannot control it

lines.zh: 我的尾巴一甩，就是一片
lines.en: One swing of my tail clears a swath

lines.zh: 这种时候，说什么都没用
lines.en: At a time like this, words do nothing

lines.zh: 我低头看你，眼里没有温度
lines.en: I lower my gaze to you, there is no warmth

lines.zh: 你以为这还是人的事吗
lines.en: Do you think this is still a human matter

lines.zh: 我抓着胸口，想不起名字
lines.en: I clutch my chest, I cannot recall a name
Go, while I still know the way
I bend and my knees sound a dull crack
I pinch it up with two fingers

lines.zh: 这东西在我掌心里像粒沙
lines.en: In my palm it is like a grain of sand
I bring it to my nose and sniff
I squeeze once, it seems broken
I am not sure how to use this
It fell, I stepped on it
My claws are too blunt to pinch it
I hold it up in the moonlight
This body does things clumsily

lines.zh: 你身上的气味，我锁定了
lines.en: I have locked onto your scent.

lines.zh: 我闻着你的味儿过来了
lines.en: I followed your scent here
That sound in my throat is the start
I straighten up, taller than the trees

lines.zh: 月亮照着我，力气涨得很快
lines.en: The moon shines on me and my strength swells

lines.zh: 你跑不掉的，这里没地方藏
lines.en: You cannot escape, there is nowhere to hide

lines.zh: 我一拳砸在地上，地都在震
lines.en: One fist to the ground and the earth shakes
I drop my shoulder, ready to charge
I bare my teeth, all of them
This forest is mine to trample

lines.zh: 我抬手，把挡路的树扫断
lines.en: I sweep a hand and break the blocking trees
Ki packs into my chest, fuller and fuller

lines.zh: 我还留着一丝清醒，你最好快点
lines.en: A shred of clarity remains, you had better hurry

lines.zh: 我抓住树干，把它掰断了
lines.en: I grab a trunk and snap it in two
I chase faster than you run
You change direction, so do I

lines.zh: 树倒了一路，那是我走过的地方
lines.en: Fallen trees mark where I have been
I clear an entire ditch in one stride
Ki blasts are tossed from my palm

lines.zh: 岩石砸下来，我用手挡开
lines.en: Rocks fall and I knock them aside
The further you run, the louder I roar

lines.zh: 我的尾巴在你身后拖出一条沟
lines.en: My tail drags a trench behind you

lines.zh: 你的脚印太小了，我踩得很准
lines.en: Your prints are small, and I step on them exactly
I smash through the trees and come straight
I do not tire, the fight only fuels me
Everything here is trembling

lines.zh: 你再往山上跑，就没退路了
lines.en: Keep climbing and you lose your way back

lines.zh: 我把手举起来，抓一把光
lines.en: I raise my hand and gather a fistful of light
Your ki is disordered, easy to track
One swing and the wind changes direction

lines.zh: 我在地上跺脚，裂缝跟着你走
lines.en: I stamp and the cracks follow you

lines.zh: 月亮在头上，我不打算停
lines.en: The moon is above, and I do not plan to stop

lines.zh: 一拳砸下去，整片地塌了
lines.en: One punch and the whole area caves in
I sweep my arm and the trees fall

lines.zh: 巴掌拍在你身上，声音很闷
lines.en: My palm hits you with a dull sound
One step and you must roll
Grab, then hurl
My teeth come down and bone goes soft

lines.zh: 我撞过去，像推倒一堵墙
lines.en: I charge like toppling a wall

lines.zh: 你飞出去，撞断了两棵树
lines.en: You fly and snap two trees
That roar was far too close

lines.zh: 我压到你身上，地面陷了
lines.en: I bear down on you and the ground sinks
You blocked it, and your hands are shaking

lines.zh: 我抓住你的腿，往地上砸
lines.en: I seize your leg and slam you down

lines.zh: 再补一拳，你就起不来了
lines.en: One more punch and you will not rise
Ki bursts on my knuckles
I lower my head, teeth above you
I have no intention of pulling back

lines.zh: 月亮出来了，我也出来了
lines.en: The moon came out, and so did I

lines.zh: 山脊上多了个影子，比树高
lines.en: A shape on the ridge, taller than the trees

lines.zh: 我落地的时候，树倒了一圈
lines.en: When I landed, a ring of trees went down
I stand up out of the forest
My scent is all over the wind
The roar arrives first, then me
This forest is too short

lines.zh: 我把手撑在地上，慢慢直起身
lines.en: I brace a hand on the ground and rise slowly

lines.zh: 月光把我的影子拉得很长
lines.en: The moon stretches my shadow long
The trees under my feet are flattened
The moment I appear, every bird takes flight

lines.zh: 那么小的月亮，那么大的我
lines.en: Such a small moon, and such a large me
I haul myself up on a trunk
My spine extends segment by segment
Several cracks open in the ground

lines.zh: 我张了张嘴，先试了试声音
lines.en: I open my mouth and test my voice
The night wind paused

lines.zh: 这么大的东西，怎么藏的
lines.en: How was something this big hidden
Fire caught my fur, the smell is foul

lines.zh: 摔下来的时候，我把地砸了个坑
lines.en: Falling, I drove a crater into the ground

lines.zh: 水太浅，可我这一身太重
lines.en: The water is shallow, but I am too heavy
The blast filled my ears with sound

lines.zh: 有个小东西扎进了我肩上
lines.en: Something small sank into my shoulder

lines.zh: 那股力气钻进毛里，扎得难受
lines.en: That force got under my fur and stings
Hunger makes my head even less clear

lines.zh: 雷落了，我全身的毛都竖了
lines.en: Lightning fell and every hair of mine stood up

lines.zh: 脚下没有地面，这么大的身子无处着力
lines.en: No ground here, and this body has nothing to push off
